comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon, projected into world space via road.project(). trigger_radius is proximity in compressed-world meters. Entries marked needs_owner_review:true need confirmation from lived knowledge — map data is not authoritative here.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow causeway strip between the airport and Harbour View — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: The roundabout where the Palisadoes strip meets Windward Road

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial waterfront community — home of the Rockfort Mineral Baths

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Residential community in East Kingston near the National Stadium

communities.name: East Kingston
communities.note: Along Mountain View Avenue, past the National Stadium

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Central Kingston junction — the city's pulse

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Financial and hotel district, home of Devon House and Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's main commercial hub — the 1813 clock tower marks the crossroads

communities.name: Six Miles
communities.note: Major junction on Spanish Town Road — gateway out of Kingston heading west

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Original capital of Jamaica — Cathedral, courthouse, and Rodney Memorial square

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community on the A1 approaching the Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is just ahead

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Busy market town in St Catherine — 'Linstead Market' is a beloved folk song

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small bauxite-industry town in St Catherine between Linstead and Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Quiet village in St Ann at the crest before the road descends toward Ocho Rios

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam and festival
communities._review_note: Coordinates estimated north of Moneague; owner to confirm exact position

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Famous gorge road canopied by bamboo and tropical ferns

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's North Coast resort town — Dunn's River Falls, cruise ships, and the journey's end
